landing.restartBody: Progress on this device will be reset.
landing.liveNote: Anonymous scores (no name, no contacts) appear on the live dashboard for the jury.

teaser.title: Your weak spot: {ability}
teaser.startTitle: This is the start, not the end
teaser.startBody: We’ve built a 4-week plan around your weak spot: {ability}.

paywall.title: Your personal 4-week training plan
paywall.focus: 2 of 3 daily exercises target your weak spot ({ability})
paywall.retest: Re-test on day 30 to see what has changed
paywall.timelineLabel: {ability} now: {score}. Day 30: measured by the re-test.
paywall.timelineNote: We don’t promise a number — on day 30 the re-test measures your real change.

onboarding.title: Your first exercise — right now, about 1 minute
onboarding.sub: Start while your result is fresh.

stroop.name: Color & word
stroop.howto: Tap the ink color of the word, not what the word says.

corsi.name: Flash order
corsi.howto: Tap the squares in the order they lit up. Each correct answer makes the next sequence longer.

series.name: Number series
series.howto: Find the rule and pick the next number.

gonogo.name: Quick reaction
gonogo.howto: Green circle — tap right away. Red circle — don’t tap.
gonogo.stage: Reaction area: tap when the green circle appears

flash41.name: FlashGrid #41
flash41.howto: Repeat the flash sequence. 2 correct in a row — level up; a mistake — level down (levels 2–9).

today.title: Today’s plan · ~3 min
today.allDone: All done for today. See you tomorrow!
today.weakHint: {n} of {total} exercises train your weak spot: {ability}.
today.retestText: A new parallel form shows what has really changed.

vote.title: Quick question: would you come back to the plan tomorrow?
vote.thanks: Thank you! The answer is anonymous and appears on the jury dashboard.

index.name: Wittio Index
index.scale: Your training progress on a 0–1000 scale
index.explain: The Index shows how regularly and how well you train — it is not IQ. Abilities are measured only by the re-test. Skipped days slow it down.

line.title: A daily reminder to keep your rhythm
line.mockNote: Demo of a LINE notification — nothing is sent.
line.bodyStreak: Time for today’s 3 exercises. Keep your streak going ({n} days)!
line.caption: Reminders arrive at the time you choose via LINE, the messenger most people use in Japan. This is a demo: no messages are sent and nothing is shared with LINE.

retest.title: Re-test every 30 days
retest.intro: Every 30 days you take the test again on a new parallel form, so you see real change — not remembered answers.
retest.baselineCaption: Your first test. Your weak spot is highlighted.
retest.simulate: Demo: we simulate {n} days of 3 exercises a day. Then your abilities are measured for real on a new test form.
retest.dueNote: 30 days have passed. Take the 1-minute re-test on a new form.
retest.resultKicker: New form vs your previous test
retest.honest: These are your real form-B results — scores can also go down.
retest.next: Next re-test in {n} days. Your plan now focuses on your new weak spot: {ability}.
retest.demoTitle: Demo: re-test just now · {n} days simulated for the index only
retest.rangeNote: In brackets: the range where your true score most likely lies. A change counts only when it is larger than the error of that task.
retest.whyBetter: Noticeably better: {abilities}. This change is larger than the measurement error.
retest.whyStable: Changes are still within the error — normal for the first weeks.
retest.whyLower: Some scores are lower this time. A short test also depends on sleep, time of day and focus. Keep the plan and check again in {n} days.
retest.nextSame: Next re-test in {n} days. The plan keeps its focus: {ability}.
retest.illoTitle: Typical picture after {n} days of regular practice
retest.illoNote: Example for someone who trains every day. Your real result is above.
retest.fastNote: Fast demo mode: 10 s tasks, so the error is wider (±27–43); the full 15 s test has ±21–38. “Stable” is the expected picture in the first month.

report.title: Weekly report
report.simulated: Includes simulated demo days (3 exercises, about 3 min a day).
report.valueText: {price} every 4 weeks (tax incl.) after a {trial} trial: {n} daily sessions, a weekly report and a re-test.

profile.title: Your ability profile
profile.resetNote: Clears all progress on this device and returns to the start.

economics.title: Loop economics
economics.sub: One monthly cohort: {trials} trials, {budget} ad budget, CAC {cac}.
economics.openedHint: today 45% · gate ≥ 60% · “opened” = finished ≥ 1 exercise within 7 days of paying (team definition)
economics.churnHint: today 0% · every charge after the first
economics.how: Charge 1 = opened × 66% + not opened × 15%. Each later charge loses today's share of payers, reduced by the churn cut. Net = after 10% refunds.
economics.footer: Data — case brief; 66% / 15% — CC-146 team estimate
